about: Each diagram type's page (examples/types/<type>.json, hand-authored, rendered to examples/types/<type>.html): its title, its intro (a sentence or two on the scenario the diagram draws), its main view (the model's root and first view: one comprehensive diagram of the type, showing every element kind, line kind, marker, compartment, stereotype and option of the type that can coexist in one picture), its alternatives (the same example in a setting that cannot coexist with the main view, such as a layout direction or a notation: each a view of the same model, a child of the main view, with what differs), and shows (the features the main view demonstrates, in the order a reader finds them, a checklist the docs page lists). A type may allow layout issues (issues, a count, with why, the reason the type's layout cannot avoid them); 0 is the default and the goal. A type still "pending" keeps its old page model (an overview of variant cards) until its comprehensive example replaces it. Plain keyboard characters; `code` in backticks.

map.title: Map examples
map.intro: Card shapes: people, a browser app, a phone, a window, a terminal, an agent, a database, a queue, a file, a package, hosts and a hook around a shop's API.

uml-class.title: Class diagram
uml-class.intro: A bookshop's sales domain: who orders, what an order holds, how it is paid for, and the shared types the classes use, in one class diagram.

alternatives.setting: Laid out right (`direction` left at its default) instead of down: the same classes, lines and presentation options; the main view runs `down`, so that generalizations put the general class above.

shows: A note (a comment with a folded corner) linked to Order by a dashed line
Packages drawn as boxes holding their classes, their names in tabs: sales, payments with card nested inside it, shared
A package-qualified name: catalog::Book, whose package the view does not show
A class with a stereotype: <<entity>> over Order
Attributes with all four visibilities: + public, - private, # protected, ~ package
A derived attribute (/total), a default (status = draft) and a multiplicity on a member (name: String [0..1])
A static attribute and a static operation, underlined (placed, find)
Operations with parameters, a return type, and parameter directions (in by, out was)
A class cut to 3 rows then "+2 more" (Customer, `present` `rows`)
An association with a label, role names, multiplicities and a navigable end (Customer places orders 0..*)
An association navigable at both ends (Customer wishes for Book: readers *, wishlist *)
Composition, a filled diamond (Order owns its lines 1..*)
Aggregation, a hollow diamond (Order and its payments 0..*)
An interface and an interface realization, dashed with a hollow triangle (Order realizes Payable)
An abstract class and an abstract operation, in italics (Payment, settle())
Generalization, a hollow triangle at the general class, two subclasses sharing it (CardPayment, GiftCardPayment)
A usage, dashed with an open arrowhead and <<use>> (CardPayment uses CardGateway)
A dependency with the <<use>> stereotype (Payable on Money)
A dependency with a label (Book keyed by Isbn)
A data type (<<dataType>> Money) and a primitive type (<<primitive>> Isbn)

uml-object.title: Object diagram examples
uml-object.intro: A UML object diagram of one placed order: ada, a Customer, linked to order1042, an Order, its two order lines, the books they are for and the card payment, each with its slots.
shows: a package box, stereotypes, a note

uml-package.title: Package diagram examples
uml-package.intro: A UML package diagram of a bookshop: the packages shared, catalog, sales, payments with card inside it, and wholesale, each a box holding its classes, joined by imports, an access, a merge and a dependency, and the profile BookshopConventions, a closed folder that sales applies.
shows: three levels deep, laid out down

uml-composite-structure.title: Composite structure diagram examples
uml-composite-structure.intro: A UML composite structure diagram of an order service: its ports on its border, four parts, two of them showing their types' ports, connectors between them, an open collaboration as a dashed ellipse and a collaboration use with its role bindings.

uml-component.title: Component diagram examples
uml-component.intro: A UML component diagram of a bookshop: Shop API a box holding Checkout, ports on their borders with delegations between them, Orders as a ball with a socket, SignIn as a rectangle, an artifact manifesting Shop API.

uml-deployment.title: Deployment diagram examples
uml-deployment.intro: A UML deployment diagram of a bookshop in production: devices and execution environments drawn as cubes and nested, artifacts deployed in them, communication paths labelled with their protocols.

uml-profile.title: Profile diagram examples
uml-profile.intro: A UML profile diagram of a bookshop's modelling conventions: a profile holding metaclasses and stereotypes with their tag definitions, extensions with filled triangles, one marked required, a package applying the profile, and a class showing its stereotypes' tags.

uml-use-case.title: Use case diagram examples
uml-use-case.intro: A UML use case diagram of a bookshop: a shopper, a member and a payment provider as stick figures, eight use cases as ellipses in the Online bookshop subject, includes and extends drawn dashed with their labels.

uml-activity.title: Activity diagram examples
uml-activity.intro: A UML activity diagram of fulfilling an order in three lanes, Order worker, Warehouse and Email service: actions, an object node, a data store, a decision and a merge, a fork and a join, and a flow final.
shows: a loop, laid out right, no lanes

uml-state-machine.title: State machine diagram examples
uml-state-machine.intro: A UML state machine diagram of an order's life: Placed with its activities, a choice, a fork into the Parcel and Payment regions of Fulfilling, In delivery with a history, Cancelled and a terminate.
shows: deep history, a junction, a note

uml-sequence.title: Sequence diagram examples
uml-sequence.intro: A UML sequence diagram of a bookshop's checkout: a shopper, the storefront, the api, payments and a receipt created on the way, their messages in time order with activation bars, an alt frame with an opt frame and an interaction use inside it.

uml-communication.title: Communication diagram examples
uml-communication.intro: A UML communication diagram of the same checkout: five lifelines joined by connectors, each link's messages a stack of numbered rows.

uml-interaction-overview.title: Interaction overview diagram examples
uml-interaction-overview.intro: A UML interaction overview diagram of buying a book: interaction uses for finding a book, checking out and emailing the receipt, a decision looping back through a merge, a fork and a join, and an inline interaction with its three lifelines.
shows: laid out right, flow final, a note

uml-timing.title: Timing diagram examples
uml-timing.intro: A UML timing diagram of one charge: two lifelines as step lines through their states on a time ruler in milliseconds, a call and its reply between them at their times, a duration constraint and a time constraint.

uml-information-flow.title: Information flow diagram examples
uml-information-flow.intro: A UML information flow diagram of what travels with an order: a shopper, components and information items, joined by dashed flow lines each naming what it conveys.

sysml-requirement.title: Requirement diagram examples
sysml-requirement.intro: A SysML requirement diagram of a city e-bike in a req frame: requirements with their ids and wrapped texts, containment crosshairs, blocks satisfying and test cases verifying them.

sysml-block-definition.title: Block definition diagram examples
sysml-block-definition.intro: A SysML block definition diagram of a city e-bike in a bdd frame: blocks with named compartments of parts, values, constraints and ports, an interface block, constraint blocks and value types.

sysml-internal-block.title: Internal block diagram examples
sysml-internal-block.intro: A SysML internal block diagram of a city e-bike: the bike as the ibd frame holding its parts, ports on their borders with flow arrows, connectors carrying DC power and phase current.
shows: frame ports, delegation, a full port
a part's own block, two delegations

sysml-parametric.title: Parametric diagram examples
sysml-parametric.intro: A SysML parametric diagram of a city e-bike's range: constraint properties with rounded corners and their expressions, parameters on their borders bound to value properties.
shows: a constraint block as the frame
a power budget, laid out down

c4.title: C4 diagram examples
c4.intro: A C4 system context diagram of a bookshop: the shopper and staff as people, the bookshop as the system in the middle, the external systems it uses in grey.

er.title: Entity-relationship diagram examples
er.intro: An entity-relationship diagram of a bookshop's database: seven tables with their key columns first, related by crow's foot ends, identifying lines solid and the rest dashed.

dfd.title: Data flow diagram examples
dfd.intro: A data flow diagram of a bookshop, level 1: three external entities, three numbered processes and two data stores, joined by labelled data flows.

flowchart.title: Flowchart examples
flowchart.intro: A flowchart of handling a returned book, laid out down: a start, input and manual input, a decision with yes and no exits, a delay, a database, a document, a connector and an end.
shows: laid out right, three exits, a loop
an on-page connector pair, a note

bpmn.title: BPMN diagram examples
bpmn.intro: A BPMN diagram of a bookshop's order to shipment: three pools, the bookshop's in two lanes, tasks, events and gateways joined by sequence flows, dashed message flows between the pools, a timer on the payment task's border.
shows: black-box pools, data, laid out down

mindmap.title: Mindmap examples
mindmap.intro: A mindmap of opening a bookshop: the root in the middle, six branches left and right, each in its own colour, joined by curves.

aws.title: AWS diagram examples
aws.intro: An AWS architecture diagram of a bookshop: a cloud, a region, a VPC, two availability zones, public and private subnets and a security group as nested boxes, fifteen services and resources drawn with their icons and full service names.

gcp.title: Google Cloud diagram examples
gcp.intro: A Google Cloud architecture diagram of a bookshop: a project, a region, a network, a subnetwork and two zones as nested boxes, nine products drawn with their icons and full service names.
shows: a generic group, lines to groups

azure.title: Azure diagram examples
azure.intro: An Azure architecture diagram of a bookshop: a subscription, a resource group, a region, a virtual network and two subnets as nested boxes, eight services drawn with their icons and full service names.
